message: Exceeded skills context budget. All skill descriptions were removed and 684 additional skills were not included in the model-visible skills list.

text: First write a plan with the update_plan tool and keep it updated as you go. Make every file change with apply_patch, never with shell scripts. Then: fix inventory.py so every test in test_inventory.py passes (restock must raise KeyError for an unknown name), add a test for restocking a known item, and write a short README.md for the module. Run `python3 -m unittest` at the end to confirm.

lines.text: # Inventory module
`inventory.py` provides small helpers for working with a list of inventory
items. Each item is a dictionary with `name`, `price`, and `quantity` fields.
- `total_value(items)` returns the sum of each item's price times its quantity.
- `low_stock(items, threshold=5)` returns names of items with quantity below
the threshold.
- `restock(items, name, amount)` adds the amount to a matching item and returns
the same list. It raises `KeyError` if no item has that name.
"""Sum price * quantity over items."""
return sum(i["price"] for i in items)
return sum(i["price"] * i["quantity"] for i in items)
"""Names of items with quantity below the threshold."""
return [i["name"] for i in items if i["quantity"] <= threshold]
return [i["name"] for i in items if i["quantity"] < threshold]
i["quantity"] += amount
return items
return items
raise KeyError(name)
def test_restock_known(self):
items = [dict(i) for i in ITEMS]
self.assertIs(restock(items, "nut", 3), items)
self.assertEqual(items[1]["quantity"], 8)

text: Spawn a subagent to review inventory.py for remaining edge cases and have it report back; then summarise its findings for me in a small markdown table. Do not change any files.

detail.output: No concrete bugs found for the documented inputs. Optional edge cases: `restock` accepts negative amounts, and duplicate names cause it to update only the first matching item. Missing required fields raise `KeyError` naturally.
